item.title: Should Dems Dare to Dream in Mississippi?
item.itunes:title: Should Dems Dare to Dream in Mississippi?
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
A top Republican super PAC is making late ad buys in a state that would have been unthinkable not long ago: Mississippi. While party officials may not think they will actually lose the Senate race in the GOP stronghold, it speaks to the rapid rise of Democratic nominee Scott Colom. We look at what a growing “blacklash” against GOP voting moves looks like. 

--- 

Guest: Fredreka Schouten, CNN National Political Writer 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin

item.title: Is This the End of the Road for Netanyahu in Israel?
item.itunes:title: Is This the End of the Road for Netanyahu in Israel?
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Israelis are heading to the polls this week in a high-stakes election that could imperil Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyhu’s grip on power. But what is motivating voters? And does the endorsement of US President Donald Trump make a difference?  

For more: Israel is holding its most important election in years. Here’s what’s at stake

--- 

Guest: Tal Shalev, CNN Senior Reporter 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin

item.title: The Curious Case of the Immortal Jellyfish
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
A type of light therapy popular in skincare could be a game changer for people undergoing IVF. Meet the first dad in the US to use a new device that helps parents bond with their premature babies. A livestream of newborn puppies is so popular in Finland, it had more views last year than the country has people. A new study offers hope for restoring damaged coral reefs. Plus, what a tiny “immortal jellyfish” could teach us about treating age-related illnesses. 

Host/Producer: Krista Bo Polanco 

Producer: Eryn Mathewson  

Senior Producer: Felicia Patinkin 

Editorial Support: Ava Bambuck, Jacqueline Howard, Lacey Russell

item.title: The Young Men Moving Away from Trump
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Republicans worked hard in 2024 to court young men who were fans of combat sports and certain podcasters. After helping fuel President Donald Trump to victory, there are signs this group has soured on him and may not even vote at all in the midterms. We explore how the party is trying to keep them around and whether Democrats are having any success either.

--- 

Guest: Steve Contorno, CNN Senior Reporter

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin
